resources.string: Run commands in separate shell sessions. Sessions continue in the background when you leave. Turning off the switch ends all sessions.
Android has disabled 3-Shell Terminal. Enable the app in its system settings, then try again.
3-Shell Terminal is disabled or not authorized in Plugin Center. Enable and authorize it before using the terminal.
Install 3-Shell Terminal from Plugin Center to use the terminal. The built-in terminal has moved into this plugin.
3-Shell Terminal requires AutoJs6 build %1$d or later. Update AutoJs6, or install a compatible plugin version from Plugin Center.
The installed 3-Shell Terminal does not provide the terminal entry this AutoJs6 build expects. Update the plugin from Plugin Center.
Remove the terminal home, installed packages and npm caches
Check whether the terminal can run node from the Node.js Runtime plugin
Run npm with --ignore-scripts so packages cannot execute install hooks (native binaries cannot run here anyway)
Delete all terminal data under %1$s? Running sessions will be closed.
A process is still running in this session. Close it anyway?

Type directly in the terminal. Long press text to select it, drag the handles to adjust the range, then choose Copy or Select all.\nSwipe the left key area for more symbols. CTRL and ALT apply to the next key.
No package.json found in the current directory
This device refused to run the Node.js launcher of the plugin, so only the system shell is available
The Node.js Runtime plugin has no launcher for ABI %1$s
Node.js Runtime plugin is not installed, so only the system shell is available
Node.js Runtime plugin is installed but not enabled or authorized in Plugin Center
The installed Node.js Runtime plugin has no terminal launcher, update it to use node and npm here
Shows terminal sessions that keep running in the background and lets you close them
The registry URL must start with https://
npm and corepack could not be prepared from the Node.js Runtime plugin, so only node and the system shell are available
yarn and pnpm are provided through corepack and are downloaded from the registry on first use. Run \"yarn --version\" or \"pnpm --version\" to activate them.
Preparing npm and corepack from the Node.js Runtime plugin...
The session keeps running in the background; use \"Close session\" to end it

The shell runs as the AutoJs6 app user with its own home directory (%1$s). The key bar provides Esc / Tab / Ctrl / Alt and the cursor keys, a long press on the screen selects text, and the menu copies or shares the transcript. node and npm become available once a Node.js Runtime plugin with terminal support is installed. Leaving the terminal keeps the session and its processes running in the background (with a notification); \"Close session\" in the menu ends it.
